annotations.title: Check whether free MCP data matches the official source

description: Return Signal Lab's Free Data Agreement Index: for fixed public datapoints (eur-usd, eur-gbp, eur-jpy, us-cpi-u, effr, us-10y) it compares values free MCP servers returned to Signal Lab's weekly read-only agreement probe and in recorded agent tests with the official publisher's free API (ECB, BLS, New York Fed, US Treasury), after allowing for rounding, and gives an agreement score per datapoint and per server, the latest official value, and servers not yet measured. Optional datapoint id or server slug narrows the result. Small samples; "not yet measured" is not a fault.
name: get_data_agreement
title: Check whether free MCP data matches the official source
